human_tolerance.notes: Familiar in yards and gardens across much of its range, and often lives near houses and settlements (Wikipedia). light_max is authored judgement.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Eggs laid March to July, with possible double brooding (Wikipedia). Range-wide statement, not a Costa Rica-specific calendar.

phases.name: territorial
phases.note: Resident across the range; no migration is described in the source.

vocalizations.description: Rather low-pitched, slow-tempo song of many slurred musical phrases. In Costa Rica the song comes at the start of the rainy season (Wikipedia).
Harsher 'tock' flight call, like the American robin's (Wikipedia).

taxonomy.note: GBIF usageKey 2490716 is ACCEPTED at SPECIES rank. Wikidata Q551736 carries GBIF 2490716 (P846), iNaturalist 12720 (P3151), NCBI 203558 (P685) and eBird clcrob (P3444). The iNaturalist taxa API also returned an active, non-extinct species taxon named Turdus grayi on 2026-11-01; that API result is not used as a licensed source.

common_names.note: English name and yigüirro from the Wikipedia article.

range.note: Wikipedia: ranges from South Texas to northern Colombia; west and north of the Isthmus of Tehuantepec it is limited to the Atlantic slope, except a population around Oaxaca City that probably originates from escaped cage birds. The listed country codes are derived from that geography; per-country evidence was not checked individually.

range.introduced.note: Oaxaca City population probably from escaped cage birds (Wikipedia).

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Wikipedia: forages on or near the ground; flies with a 'tock' flight call. Hop and walk are authored from thrush foraging behaviour.

traits.respiration.note: Authored: birds breathe with lungs. This is a class-level fact, not a species-specific claim from a source.

traits.metamorphosis.note: Authored: birds have direct development with no larval metamorphosis.

traits.nest_type.note: Wikipedia: builds a heavy cup nest on a firm support above the ground.

traits.perching.note: Authored from its Turdus habit of perching in shrubs and trees; the source does not state perching explicitly.

traits.size_class.note: From mass_kg (0.075 kg falls in the Small band, below 1 kg).

traits.mass_kg.note: Wikipedia gives 74-76 g average; midpoint 75 g used. EltonTraits 1.0 BodyMass-Value is 79.5 g (Dunning 2008) and is consistent within range. Records disagree slightly; the midpoint is a conversion, not a single measured value.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Row X=763 of ELEscholer2020_data.csv: Turdus grayi, Rogers & Meisel (2009), Heredia Province, Costa Rica, mark-recapture, 5-year duration, survival 0.63, SE 0.14, migration 'resident'. Equation: lifespan_y = -1 / ln(S) = -1 / ln(0.63) = 2.16, rounded to 2.2. Assumptions: constant annual adult survival (exponential hazard), single population, single study, and this 'survival' column is apparent survival, which can be biased low where emigration occurs. The SE range 0.49-0.77 gives 1.4-3.8 years. This is a typical adult-stage estimate, not a maximum or captive age.

traits.diet.note: EltonTraits 1.0 BirdFuncDat row for Turdus grayi: Diet-Inv 30, Diet-Fruit 60, Diet-Vect 10 (vertebrate ectotherms), all other categories 0; recorded as fractions. Schema has one 'vertebrate' key, so the Vect share is placed there. Wikipedia: forages for fruit or invertebrates.

traits.social.note: Wikipedia: forages singly or in pairs, but flocks may feed high in fruiting trees.

traits.activity_pattern.note: EltonTraits Nocturnal = 0. Wikipedia describes song and daytime foraging; no nocturnal activity is reported.

traits.defense.note: Authored: the source reports the species mobbing raptors around its nest. Fleeing to cover is a judgement.

traits.wariness.note: Judgement: common and confiding in gardens and near houses (Wikipedia), but still flushes from approach.

habitat.use.note: EltonTraits gives ForStrat-ground 0, understory 20 and midhigh 80. Wikipedia says it forages on or near the ground. The 0.3 ground / 0.7 arboreal split is an authored reconciliation of those two statements.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Authored: shrub thicket cover; the nest is in shrubs or trees.

habitat.resources.note: Weights follow the EltonTraits diet split (invertebrate 30, fruit 60) and the documented cup nest.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Wikipedia: familiar in yards and gardens; lives near houses and settlements. light_max is judgement.

seasonal.strategy.note: Scholer row X=763 has migration 'resident'. Wikipedia describes no migration.

seasonal.phases.note: Breeding from the Wikipedia statement of eggs laid March to July. Not a Costa Rica-specific calendar: the source gives no regional split.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Egg, juvenile and adult from the nesting description; no stage durations are given.

vocalizations.song.note: Wikipedia: song is rather low-pitched with a slow steady tempo; Costa Rican song comes at the start of the rainy season. season_months 3-7 is derived from the breeding window, not a Costa Rica-specific song calendar.

vocalizations.alarm.note: Wikipedia: tock flight call, harsher than the American robin's. Alarm context is authored.

look.note: Authored from Wikipedia plumage notes (brownish, lighter below, yellow-green bill, pinkish legs, reddish iris). Proportions and palette are judgement.

behavior.note: Local program bt-turdus-grayi-v1 in species/turdus-grayi/behavior.json; see the PR for the reasons shared bt-perching-songbird-v1 does not fit.

conservation.note: Wikidata P141 = least concern (Q211005). The IUCN assessment year was not checked.
